references.text: Moses sent messengers to the king of Edom with a similar diplomatic appeal before war
Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, with a peaceful request to pass through the land
Moses sent messengers to King Sihon in Heshbon with an offer of peace
Ben-Hadad sent messengers to the king of Israel, following the same diplomatic pattern of sending envoys before conflict
Amaziah sent messengers to Joash of Israel with a challenge to war, a similar diplomatic confrontation
Jephthah argues that the king of Ammon does wrong by going to war against Israel
Jesus uses the expression 'Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί' (What have I to do with you), which is parallel to the Hebrew 'מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ'
